text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Meow. Meooow. ...Woof. Woof, woof.
Woof,
meow... woof.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ya tryin' to be a cat or a dog? More

importantly... the hell are ya doin'?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm a pet. Some time ago, you mentioned wanting to get yourself a pet. So I thought for your birthday present, I could be your pet...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...If you're not pullin' my chain, then
I'mma start
gettin' real worried, real fast.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I-I get it! I'm not actually a pet! But, isn't
a
birthday a really important day? So I
wanted to
celebrate yours, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But then you said you would rather save
the
money instead of celebrating. That's
why I did a
lot of thinking and decided
on this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...That's why you're pullin' this circus show? Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're a cat or dog, ya still
gotta eat,
don'tcha? Look, food's on you
today—but I'll let
ya pick.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah, I'll treat you, let's go! Oops, I

mean—mewoof!
